summary: Iodine is a networking tool that tunnels IPv4 traffic over the Domain Name System protocol. It allows you to operate a SOCKS5 proxy listener when standard network access is restricted or filtered by routing traffic through DNS queries.
goodFor: It is suited for advanced network administrators who need to bypass strict firewall restrictions in controlled laboratory or testing environments.
watchOut: The project has low maintenance activity and no recent releases, which means unpatched bugs or compatibility issues may go unaddressed.
deployNotes: As a C application packaged as a deb, it typically runs as a system daemon on Linux servers without requiring a database or TLS termination proxy.
